verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Signifyd has an extensive REST API reference (endpoints for Sale, Checkout, Decision, Chargeback, Webhooks, etc.) but nothing in the pack indicates an interactive console, runnable code samples, or 'try it now' functionality typical of an AI-native API reference. Missing for 10: any mention of interactive/runnable request builder, live sandbox execution, or SDK-embedded runnable snippets.
